summary.en: Unofficial community PyArrow 26.0.1 wheel for Windows ARM64 with CUDA, smoke-tested by its author on an RTX Spark N1X.
summary.zh-TW: 社群非官方的 Windows ARM64 PyArrow 26.0.1 wheel（含 CUDA），作者曾在 RTX Spark N1X 上做基本測試。

caveats.en: Not an Apache Arrow or NVIDIA release. Built for CPython 3.14 and CUDA Toolkit 13.5.0; the author's tests (import, Parquet round trip, CUDA copy) were limited and used one driver.
caveats.zh-TW: 並非 Apache Arrow 或 NVIDIA 官方版本。僅針對 CPython 3.14 與 CUDA Toolkit 13.5.0 建置；作者的測試（匯入、Parquet 往返、CUDA 複製）範圍有限，且只用一個驅動程式版本。

evidence.title: README: PyArrow 26.0.1 Windows ARM64 CUDA build, tested on RTX Spark N1X
